blocks.text: You can add ignore alert filters to exclude the generation of alerts for less critical violations or for alerts that you don't want to receive notifications for. For example, you can add an ignore alert filter to ignore alerts generated for policies with low severity or for a specific cloud account.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Policy Exceptions.
The Ignore Alert Filter page appears.
On the Ignore Alert Filter page, click Add Ignore Filter.
See image.
The Ignore Alert Filter page appears.
On the Ignore Alert Filter page, in the General Information section:
Ignore Filter Name: Enter a unique name for the filter.
Filter Description: (Optional) Enter a description for the filter.
See image.
Click Next.
In the Filter Scope section, select at least one of the following filters:
Policies
Select the policy, category, or severity. Depending on your selection, one of the following additional fields is displayed:
Category: Select the threat category (Public Exposure, External Users, Risky Credentials, Malicious Access, Data Loss, Data Governance) from the drop-down menu.
Severity: Select the policy severity (Critical, High, Medium, or Low) from the drop-down menu.
Select Policies: Select to view the Select Existing Policies page, and select the required policies (Custom and Predefined) from the table.
See image.
See image.
By default, the All Policies option is selected.
Cloud Accounts
Select the cloud accounts, business units, or cloud provider. Depending on your selection, one of the following additional fields is displayed:
Select Accounts: Select the cloud accounts from the drop-down menu.
Business Units: Select the business units from the drop-down menu.
Cloud Provider: Select the cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP, On-Premises, or Snowflake) from the drop-down menu.
See image.
By default, the All Account option is selected.
Tags
Click the Tags drop-down menu and choose Select Tags. Click the Add Tags icon that appears to include the required tags.
See image.
By default, the All Tags option is selected.
Resources
Click the Resources drop-down menu and choose Resource Type. Select the required data stores from the drop-down menu.
See image.
By default, the All Resources option is selected.
DLP Engines
Click the DLP Engines drop-down menu and choose Specific DLP Engines. Select the required DLP engines.
See image.
By default, the All DLP Engines option is selected.
See image.
Click Next.
Review the ignore alert filter configuration, then click Finish.
See image.

If the selected filters of the filter scope are deleted (e.g., policies are deleted, accounts are offboarded, or the business unit is deleted), the ignore alert filter is disabled, and an exclamation mark is displayed indicating the filter is invalid. See image.
The ignore alert filter is added to the ignore alert filter table and is enabled by default. The newly triggered alerts matching these filter criteria are ignored.
